notes.title: Improvement Schedules for Summer of Love
notes.content:
Hi!

Before going into the details, please let me introduce [b]Summer of Love[/b] first. This game was developed in 2020-2022, and it was finished in the Summer of 2022. One year and a half passed, I put it on Steam finally. But because the first half of it was developed when I didn't have the current PC, the image quality wasn't as good as I can do right now. Not to mention this: my English at that time was very bad.

Therefore, I want to improve it by:
[list]
[*] [b]Writing[/b]:
[olist]

[*] Check and revamp the writing (dialogues, story-tellings...).
[*] Add sound effects (mostly erotic sounds).
[*] Fix a mistake in the demo (lacking an image).[/olist]
[*] [b]Graphics[/b]:
[olist]

[*] Add more images to make the animations look nicer.
[*] Re-render a large number of images to make them look nicer.[/olist]
[/list]
And the game will be automatically updated for everyone who has already been owning it.

Thank you for supporting me!

Best Regards,

[b]Captain Kitty[/b]
